nodes.description: Public payable mint function enforcing sale state, supply cap, price, whitelist and private-sale limits, then minting tokens to msg.sender.
Public function letting an address claim free mints up to its whitelist claimAmount while sale is active.
onlyOwner function deriving startingIndex from blockhash of startingIndexBlock with a late-call fallback.
Transfers the whole contract balance to claimEthAddress when the caller equals that address.
Returns metadata URI, offsetting tokenId by startingIndex modulo TOTAL_SUPPLY.
onlyOwner function creating or updating a whitelist entry with claimAmount and hasMinted.
View function reporting whether an address has a whitelist entry.
onlyOwner function minting reserve tokens using the current supply plus loop index.
Internal safe mint that mints a token then verifies the ERC721 receiver callback.
Internal function performing an external onERC721Received call on contract recipients.
Constant mint price of 0.1 ether per token.
Constant maximum collection size of 8888.
Constant reveal timestamp (0) compared against block.timestamp.
Constant public mint cap per transaction (10).
Constant private/whitelist mint cap per address (20).
Constant maximum free-claim amount per transaction (25).
Storage index used to shuffle revealed token identifiers.
Storage block number recorded to seed the starting index randomness.
Mapping of address to Whitelist struct holding addr, claimAmount and hasMinted.
Payable multisig address authorized to withdraw contract ETH.
Public flag gating public and claim minting.
Public flag selecting the private (whitelist) mint branch.
Ownable storage holding the contract owner address.
Caller-controlled address used for minting recipient, whitelist lookup and owner checks.
Block timestamp compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to set startingIndexBlock.
External ETH transfer to claimEthAddress via transfer().
External functionCall invoking onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
Unchecked addition supply + i used as the reserved token id.
startingIndex derived from blockhash of startingIndexBlock (weak randomness source).
numberOfTokens parameter of mintGEVOLS controlling loop iterations and price.
numberOfTokens parameter of claimFreeMints controlling claimed amount.
addr parameter of reserveGEVOLS receiving reserved tokens.
amount parameter of reserveGEVOLS controlling number of reserved mints.
tokenId parameter of tokenURI offset by startingIndex.
Local mintIndex set to totalSupply() before each _safeMint.
Loop counter i used in reserveGEVOLS and mint loops.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the mint recipient and the whitelist entry used for minting.
numberOfTokens parameter drives loop count, price and cap checks in mintGEVOLS.
PRICE is used in the ETH payment validation.
TOTAL_SUPPLY bounds the total minted amount.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP is compared with block.timestamp to set startingIndexBlock.
MAX_PER_TX bounds public mint quantity.
MAX_MINT_WHITELIST bounds private mint quantity and hasMinted accumulation.
whitelist mapping is read and updated for the minter.
saleIsActive gates whether minting is allowed.
privateSaleIsActive selects private versus public mint branch.
block.timestamp is a timestamp dependency controlling startingIndexBlock assignment.
msg.sender receives the claimed tokens and its whitelist entry is decremented.
numberOfTokens parameter drives claim limit checks and loop count.
TOTAL_SUPPLY bounds the claimed supply.
MAX_CLAIM bounds the per-transaction claim amount.
whitelist claimAmount is validated against and decremented by the claim.
saleIsActive gates whether claiming is allowed.
block.timestamp is a timestamp dependency controlling startingIndexBlock assignment.
claimEthAddress is both the authorization check and the transfer recipient.
msg.sender must equal claimEthAddress to withdraw ETH.
startingIndex is written by setStartingIndex.
startingIndexBlock is read for blockhash and block.number arithmetic.
TOTAL_SUPPLY is used as the modulo base for the starting index.
startingIndex offsets the requested tokenId.
TOTAL_SUPPLY is used as the modulo base for the token id.
tokenId parameter participates in the URI id computation.
whitelist entry is written by addAddressToWhitelist.
_owner enforces the onlyOwner authorization on addAddressToWhitelist.
whitelist entry is read by isWhitelisted.
totalSupply derived from TOTAL_SUPPLY context is used as the reserve base id.
_owner enforces the onlyOwner authorization on reserveGEVOLS.
_owner enforces the onlyOwner authorization on setStartingIndex.
mintGEVOLS calls _safeMint in its minting loop.
claimFreeMints calls _safeMint in its claiming loop.
reserveGEVOLS calls _safeMint in its reserve loop.
mintGEVOLS calls isWhitelisted during private sale validation.
addAddressToWhitelist calls isWhitelisted to prevent duplicates.
claimETH executes the external ETH transfer to claimEthAddress.
reserveGEVOLS performs unchecked addition supply + i for token ids.
setStartingIndex derives the index from blockhash of startingIndexBlock.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received after state changes, enabling reentrant receiver callbacks.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external onERC721Received call into an untrusted recipient contract.

normalization_plan.reason: The mint quantity parameter is only meaningful within mintGEVOLS and should collapse into that function node.
The claim quantity parameter is only meaningful within claimFreeMints and should collapse into that function node.
The recipient parameter is only used inside reserveGEVOLS and should merge into that function node.
The reserve amount parameter is only used inside reserveGEVOLS and should merge into that function node.
The token id parameter is only meaningful within tokenURI and should collapse into that function node.
The local mintIndex is fed directly into _safeMint and should merge into that callee node.
The loop counter local is confined to reserveGEVOLS and should merge into that function node.
